messages:
Maria (Sec PM): quick sync — SOC2 prep: we need clear evidence ownership + a minimal export path for audit requests.
Ajay (Eng Manager): +1. propose Export MVP: per-tenant audit-log dump + manifest, S3 encrypted. low-risk.
Nisha (Product): customer asks: healthcare client needs 7yr retention + legal-hold flag. Is that in scope?
Katie (Legal): legal-hold UX is product + legal. Need ability to freeze deletion and tag evidence samples.
Oliver (Infra Eng): HSM/KMS integration for private customers is heavy. For MVP we can use customer-managed KMS only for keys; HSM postponed.
Maria (Sec PM): acceptance criteria draft: 1) export path with tamper-evident manifest, 2) per-tenant retention policy, 3) legal-hold flag, 4) test evidence sample of 500 events.
Ajay (Eng Manager): estimate: export API + job runner ~2 sprints, manifest signing + tests + retention enforcement + 1 sprint. total 3 sprints.
Maria (Sec PM): tradeoffs: 7yr retention for all tenants adds infra cost. Suggest tiered retention: default 90d, paid 7yr.
Nisha (Product): agree. Also need UI for legal team to request evidence exports. Assign to support + product.
Katie (Legal): confirm on sampling size: SOC2 auditor wants representative sample; 500 seems OK but we should make it configurable.
Oliver (Infra Eng): sample export command (devops) — example:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -X POST https://platform.redwood.ai/v1/exports \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tn-123","from":"2024-01-01","to":"2024-03-31","sample_size":500}'
```
Maria (Sec PM): nice. infra-bot will create ticket and CI checks.
infra-bot: created epic SEC-EXPORTS-101, linked to sprint-52.
Ajay (Eng Manager): owner for export API: @Oliver. Owner for UI/legal workflow: @Nisha. Maria will drive acceptance.
Nisha (Product): I'll draft a PRD by Mon 2024-05-06 with mockups and flows.
Katie (Legal): I'll provide legal-hold policy language and audit request checklist by Thu.
Maria (Sec PM): follow-ups: 1) Oliver to prototype signing manifest (due 2 weeks), 2) Ajay to confirm infra cost estimate, 3) Nisha + Katie to align on UX and doc.
Ajay (Eng Manager): one more: need to decide whether logs are redacted or raw for exports. Security suggests redacted by default.
Katie (Legal): auditors usually want raw with redaction annotations. We'll document redaction policy.
Maria (Sec PM): marking as OKR-related: Objective: Secure, auditable evidence; Key Result: Export flow + retention tiers released in Q3.
Oliver (Infra Eng): will report progress in eng-security channel weekly. rough timeline looks doable.
Maria (Sec PM): thanks — meeting if needed mid-next-week. :thumbsup:
